rows.en: ＊Riko＊＠１０８＿００８What are you spacing out for?!￥So I came to your room. No need￥to look so shocked, is there?!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿００９Say, looks like you really￥worked hard this time!＝＠１０８＿０１０Your scores totally surprised￥me! Who knew you were the￥slow-and-steady type?
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１１Come on! I'm actually￥complimenting you! Quit standing￥there. Say something!
Well, I expected it.
I wasn't really trying.
Well, I expected it.
I wasn't really trying.
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１２Hmph. Pretty full of yourself.
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１３Well, that's fine. It makes you￥more fun to compete with!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１４Scores like that without trying?￥That's pretty impressive!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１５I guess all that serious￥training is finally paying￥off, huh?
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１６Looks like I underestimated￥you a little until now!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１７Keep scores like this up, and￥someday you might even make it￥onto my rival list!
What's that?
I'd rather not be on it.
What's that?
Not interested.
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１８It's a list of everyone I've￥accepted as a rival.
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０１９It's not on a computer or￥anything, though. It's just up￥here, in my head!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０２０Oh, what am I saying?!￥It's not like you've made the￥list yet or anything!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０２１Don't worry. One lucky score￥isn't nearly enough to get you￥on it!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０２２Personally, if you can just keep￥your scores where they are...
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０２３you'd be worth competing with,￥and I'd kind of like that!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０２４But that's just how I feel.￥You work hard for your own￥sake, got it?!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿０２５Well then,￥see you at training!
